senses.gloss_en: finger heart (a small heart made with the thumb and index finger)

examples.en: His views are completely opposed to mine.

senses.gloss_en: oval; egg-shaped (especially of a face)

examples.vi: Cô ấy có khuôn mặt trái xoan rất xinh.
examples.en: She has a very pretty oval face.

examples.en: Everyone in their youth cherishes lofty ambitions.

senses.gloss_en: in the prime of life; in middle age and full vigour

examples.en: He is in the prime of life, still full of energy.

senses.gloss_en: to get out of the way; to step aside

examples.vi: Tránh ra, xe đang đến kìa!
examples.en: Get out of the way, a car is coming!

headword: tránh vỏ dưa gặp vỏ dừa

senses.gloss_en: out of the frying pan into the fire (literally: dodging a melon rind only to meet a coconut shell)

notes: merged the literal rendering (1) into the idiomatic meaning (2)

senses.gloss_en: to avoid; to keep away from

examples.vi: Trẻ em nên tránh xa ổ điện.
examples.en: Children should keep away from electrical sockets.

senses.gloss_en: sakae naa (a tree, Combretum quadrangulare)

senses.gloss_en: staring; wide-eyed and fixed (of a gaze)

examples.vi: Cậu bé nhìn trân trối vào chiếc máy bay.

senses.gloss_en: those who have a hard time resent those better off (literally: the tethered buffalo hates the grazing buffalo)

notes: merged the literal rendering (1) into the figurative meaning (2)

headword: trâu bò húc nhau, ruồi muỗi chết

senses.gloss_en: when the powerful clash, the weak bystanders suffer (literally: when buffaloes and cattle butt heads, flies and mosquitoes die)

examples.vi: Hai sếp đấu nhau, nhân viên khổ. Trâu bò húc nhau, ruồi muỗi chết.

senses.gloss_en: an older person with a much younger partner, robbing the cradle (mocking; literally: an old buffalo nibbling young grass)

senses.gloss_en: water buffalo

examples.vi: Trâu nước thích ngâm mình dưới bùn.
examples.en: Water buffalo like to soak in the mud.

senses.gloss_en: lazy; idle; bone-idle

examples.vi: Thằng bé trây lười, chẳng chịu làm gì cả.
examples.en: That boy is bone-idle and won't do anything.

senses.gloss_en: the higher you climb, the harder you fall; the bigger they are, the harder they fall

examples.vi: Con đừng ham chức quyền quá, trèo cao té đau đó.

senses.gloss_en: nuthatch (a small bird that climbs tree trunks)

examples.vi: Chim trèo cây thường bám đầu xuống dưới trên thân cây.

senses.gloss_en: tré (a heavily seasoned pork dish, a specialty of Central Vietnam)

senses.gloss_en: impotent, unable to get or keep an erection (literally: the upper commands, the lower does not obey)

senses.gloss_en: online; on the internet

examples.en: His friends often tease him because he blushes easily.

examples.vi: Cây trùm gọng mọc nhiều ở ven biển.

examples.vi: Nhân vật chính trùng sinh về lại thời học sinh.

senses.gloss_en: round and plump

senses.gloss_en: a kind of freshwater mussel (Lanceolaria fruhstorferi)
